submit.title: Submit a property
submit.subtitle: Tell us about the property and attach its documents. Our team reviews every submission.
submit.hiddenNotice: Your property will NOT be visible to the public when you submit it. It is reviewed by the platform team first and listed only after it has been approved and published by an admin.

fields.title: Title
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the property, its location and what makes it attractive.
fields.totalValueHint: Calculated from share price × total shares. Adjust if needed.

photos.hint: Add up to {{max}} photos (JPG/PNG, max 8 MB each). The first one is the cover image.

errors.max: You can attach up to {{max}} photos.

documents.intro: Attach the documents for the property and its owner. They are seen only by the review team — the admin decides what is shown to buyers.
documents.formats: PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP · max 15 MB each
documents.badType: "{{name}}" is not a supported file type.

descs.ownership: Title deed, sale contract or registry extract proving ownership.
descs.owner_identity: Passport or national ID of the owner / authorised signatory.
descs.company_registration: Commercial registration if the owner or developer is a company.
descs.valuation: Latest valuation report from an accredited valuer.
descs.financial: Financial study, feasibility study or projections.
descs.other: Floor plans, surveys or any other useful documents.

errors.generic: We couldn't submit the property. Please check the form and try again.

success.title: Property submitted for review
success.desc: We received your property with {{images}} photo(s) and {{documents}} document(s). It is not public yet.
success.uploadFailures: {{count}} file(s) could not be uploaded — you can send them from Messages.
success.step1: Review — our team checks the property details and documents.
success.step2: Questions or changes — if anything is missing, you'll get a message in your Messages inbox.
success.step3: Approval — once everything is in order, the submission is approved.
success.step4: Publication — the platform team completes the listing and publishes it. Only then can buyers see it.
success.messagesTitle: Keep an eye on your Messages
success.messagesDesc: All review notes, document requests and results are sent to the Messages section of your dashboard (and by email).

descs.pending: Our team is reviewing your submission. It is not public yet.
descs.requires_changes: The team asked for changes. Update the property and resubmit.
descs.approved: Approved. The platform team will publish it soon.
descs.rejected: This submission was not approved. See Messages for the reason.

status.resubmitted: Resubmitted — the team has been notified.

messages.title: Messages
messages.subtitle: Notes and requests from the Capimax RT team about your properties and documents.
messages.empty: No messages yet. Review notes and requests from our team will appear here.
messages.replyPlaceholder: Write a reply to the team…
messages.sendFailed: The message could not be sent. Please try again.
messages.uploaded: Document uploaded. The team has been notified.
messages.uploadFailed: The document could not be uploaded.
